selection_reason: GPT semantic review of the asset-verified live snapshot and evidence-tiered SPM Hunt Playbook v2. This wave deliberately excludes obvious hardware/construction/sole-source/RFI/set-aside false positives from the broad review pool and spans genuinely plausible web, graphic-design, translation, print-broker, social and media-monitoring services. Historical priors only affect review order. DCE must resolve references, turnover, staffing, certifications, onsite, insurance, subcontracting, delivery, IP/security and submission gates before any final GREEN/SUPER_GREEN decision.
